project.title: Integrated Creative Wellbeing Program for Residential Facility
project.objective: Design and pilot a multidisciplinary creative wellbeing program for residents in a hospitality-style accommodation facility.
deliverables: Session schedule and room usage plan
Staff training and safety protocol pack
constraints: Program must run within existing accommodation facility opening hours
All activities must comply with health care and safety legislation
No structural changes to the building or major capital expenses
Respect residents' religious and cultural practices at all times
Security and emergency procedures must remain fully enforceable
Data collection must protect resident confidentiality

risks.risk: Low resident participation due to unclear communication or anxiety about new activities.
risks.mitigation: Use simple information materials, offer taster sessions, and allow opt-in with flexible attendance.

risks.risk: Program activities conflict with religious practices or personal beliefs.
risks.mitigation: Minister of religion reviews content, builds alternative options, and sets clear opt-out guidelines.

risks.risk: Safety incidents during movement-based or group sessions.
risks.mitigation: Sergeant and accommodation manager define safety limits, supervision ratios, and emergency response steps.

risks.risk: Staff workload constraints limit consistent delivery of sessions.
risks.mitigation: Create realistic schedule, cross-train staff, and prioritize high-impact sessions in the pilot phase.

risks.risk: Confidentiality breaches when sharing resident progress across disciplines.
risks.mitigation: Define minimal necessary data sharing rules and anonymized reporting templates.

themes.why_relevant: Multiple therapeutic, operational, and spiritual roles must coordinate to deliver a coherent program.
Movement, group work, and emotional processing require clear safety and escalation protocols.
Residents have diverse beliefs that must be respected in all creative and therapeutic activities.
Program must fit within room availability, staffing levels, and budget constraints of the facility.
Need simple ways to monitor engagement and wellbeing changes without clinical overreach.
Clear, accessible information is needed to build trust and encourage participation.

backlog.task: Design music-based therapeutic session templates tailored to resident profiles
definition_of_done: At least three session templates documented with goals and activities
Contraindications and safety notes included for each template
Templates reviewed by minister of religion for cultural sensitivity
Templates stored in shared program curriculum document

backlog.task: Create movement and dance-based group session plan for mixed-ability residents
definition_of_done: Plan includes warm-up, core activity, and cool-down variations
Adaptations for limited mobility and assistive devices documented
Safety checks and space requirements clearly listed
Plan approved by sergeant and accommodation manager

backlog.task: Define overall program structure and weekly schedule for the 8-week pilot
definition_of_done: Weekly calendar drafted with session types, times, and capacity
No conflicts with meal times, cleaning, or major facility events
Schedule validated with accommodation manager and frontline staff
Final version shared in channel and stored in shared sheet

backlog.task: Map available rooms and resources in the facility for program use
definition_of_done: List of suitable rooms with capacity and accessibility notes created
Time slots for each room reserved for the pilot period
Any noise or disturbance constraints documented
Room usage plan aligned with housekeeping and maintenance

backlog.task: Develop spiritual and reflective components that can be integrated into sessions
definition_of_done: Short reflection or ritual options drafted for different faith backgrounds
Clear guidance on when and how to offer spiritual elements
Opt-in and opt-out process described for residents
Content reviewed by music therapist and dance therapist for fit

backlog.task: Define safety, emergency, and incident reporting procedures for sessions
definition_of_done: Checklist for pre-session safety checks created
Clear escalation path for medical or behavioral incidents documented
Incident report template drafted and shared
Procedures validated with accommodation manager

backlog.task: Create resident information and consent materials for the pilot
definition_of_done: One-page resident info sheet drafted in plain language
Consent and opt-out options clearly explained
Materials reviewed for legal and ethical compliance by minister of religion
Print-ready and digital versions prepared

backlog.task: Set up simple wellbeing and engagement tracking method
definition_of_done: Short pre- and post-session mood check format defined
Attendance and engagement fields added to tracking sheet
Confidentiality and data storage approach documented
Team trained on how to complete tracking consistently

backlog.task: Align program operations with facility staffing and budget constraints
definition_of_done: Staffing impact assessment completed for each session type
Any overtime or additional costs estimated
Feasible staffing model agreed with sergeant and membership manager
Summary shared with facility management

backlog.task: Define resident eligibility and referral criteria for the pilot
definition_of_done: Inclusion and exclusion criteria drafted with focus on wellbeing needs
Process for referrals from care staff documented
Safeguards for vulnerable residents described
Criteria reviewed by music therapist and dance therapist

backlog.task: Develop staff briefing and micro-training session on the new program
definition_of_done: Briefing outline covering safety, roles, and boundaries created
Short training session plan with key messages prepared
Accommodation manager confirms logistics for staff briefing
Slides or handouts uploaded to shared document

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot evaluation findings and recommendations
definition_of_done: Attendance and wellbeing tracking data summarized
Qualitative feedback from residents and staff captured
Key successes, issues, and recommendations listed
Evaluation summary shared with all stakeholders

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on overall program scope, objectives, and roles for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the integrated creative wellbeing pilot project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the 8-week pilot duration and high-level program objectives.
Agree on primary responsibilities for each role across the program.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize weekly schedule, room allocation, and staffing feasibility.
threads_plan.trigger: Membership manager shares first draft of the weekly schedule and asks for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final weekly schedule and room usage plan for the pilot.
Confirm staffing model and supervision requirements for all sessions.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on safety, emergency, and incident reporting procedures.
threads_plan.trigger: Sergeant posts draft safety and incident protocols for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the safety checklist and emergency escalation steps.
Select the final incident reporting template to use during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define resident eligibility, consent, and communication approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Minister of religion and membership manager share draft eligibility and consent materials.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve resident eligibility and referral criteria for the pilot.
Approve final resident information and consent materials and distribution plan.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on tracking, evaluation, and reporting for the pilot outcomes.
threads_plan.trigger: Music therapist shares proposal for wellbeing tracking and evaluation summary structure.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the minimal wellbeing and engagement data to collect.
Confirm format and audience for the final pilot evaluation report.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in on upcoming sessions, risks, and room changes.
Weekly short debrief thread summarizing resident engagement and notable observations.
Pre-pilot and mid-pilot review threads to adjust schedule, safety, or eligibility rules.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread focused on what to keep, change, or drop.
Ad-hoc incident follow-up threads referencing safety protocols and lessons learned.
